_meta.purpose: Hand-curated change entries for the /changes/ page of the Trenton, Missouri directory, per v2 design spec section 1.2. The page also generates entries from listings.json status and disputed fields; this file holds the first-class narrative changes.
_meta.note: Every entry carries at least one source with url, publisher and retrieved_at, copied from existing records or content. An entry with whenPrecision "unknown" must not render a date.

changes.headline: The Trenton Republican-Times stopped publishing
changes.detail: Trenton's newspaper since 1864 was closed after its June 19, 2025 issues. Its former website still resolves and still ranks in search, but it no longer publishes.

changes.headline: The Trenton Telegraph launched as the town's newspaper
changes.detail: A weekly newspaper for Trenton and Grundy County launched in September 2025, owned by the Grundy County Industrial Development Corporation with CherryRoad Media providing management. It succeeded the closed Republican-Times.

changes.headline: The state license office serving Trenton closed
changes.detail: The office serving Trenton closed after May 2023 with a transition to a new contractor announced; we cannot confirm what replaced it

changes.headline: The Grundy County Museum has two candidate web domains
changes.detail: Sources resolve to both grundycountymuseum.webnode.page and grundycountymuseum.org for the museum. We publish the webnode address, which is the one sources resolved to, with the disagreement disclosed on the listing.

changes.headline: NCMC's Ketcham Community Center completed its renovations
changes.detail: The mid-2025 renovation turned out to be a two-week weight-area and track project; the building reopened July 22, 2025, and the college later held an open house celebrating the completed upgrades.
